methodology.core_selection: Available FanDuel alternate with American odds inclusively between -350 and -150; choose price numerically closest to -250; exact distance tie resolves to the more negative price.
methodology.floor: Immediately lower available alternate threshold than Core.
methodology.ceiling: Immediately higher available alternate threshold than Core, regardless of its historical HR.
methodology.alternate_hr: Count locked Stage 1 L10 observations greater than or equal to the alternate threshold; denominator remains exactly 10.
methodology.candidate_narrowing: Carry forward only records where at least one available Floor, Core, or Ceiling alternate has historical HR >=7/10, matching the model's R16 minimum final-leg HR. Exclude records without a qualifying Core or where every available band is below 7/10. This is a candidate gate only, not a bet selection.
methodology.excluded_analysis: No injury, weather, matchup, role, game-script, line-movement, price-movement, or cross-book analysis performed.
